xlsx_issues.empty_kept: Sheet {sheet} is empty: nothing was read from it, {n} elements stay as they are. Other sheets can still be applied.
xlsx_issues.empty_none: Sheet {sheet} is empty: nothing was read from it. Other sheets can still be applied.
xlsx_issues.unreadable: Sheet {sheet} could not be read, its part of the file is damaged: nothing was taken from it and its elements stay as they are. Other sheets can still be applied.
xlsx_issues.formulas: The formulas on sheet {sheet} could not be read, so a calculated value cannot be told from an edit: nothing was taken from this sheet. Other sheets can still be applied.
